author: The B1M
description:
HUGE news! We're giving you the chance to win a free trip to the ITER nuclear fusion construction site in France with me!! You can enter now at the link in our channel bio 🏗️

Key terms and conditions 👇

1. To enter you must preorder a hardback copy of Mega Builds by Fred Mills from any UK book retailer and submit the form via Survey Monkey. Preorders from before the start of this competition or linked to the How To Academy event are eligible.

2. Entry closes  23:59 BST on 27 April 2026 and the winner will be notified on 28 April 2026. The winner must claim their prize within 3 days of the promoter sending notification.

3. Winner must be UK based, over 18 years of age, have a valid passport and right to enter the EU.

4. We are not responsible for travel/health insurance, loss or damage.

5. No alternative date will be offered therefore the winner must be available on 27 and 28 May 2026 for this prize. 

6. In the event that you cannot make these dates, no alternative dates will be
title: Win a FREE TRIP to a Nuclear Fusion Mega Build
